FireClient Automatic Release Updater
Cryptographically verified builds for Windows, macOS (Apple Silicon & Intel), and Linux (.AppImage / .deb / .tar.gz) from github.com/untitledinfo/verifed-fireclient.
Installed: v2.2.7 → Latest: Checking…
SHA-256 DIGEST d5f9ca5a1e84bc19232f4424dbfa32d9e6263da3c8ecabcf7ee231dad96f78a8
Windows Native Desktop Edition
Native C++20 Win32 + WebView2 runtime with DPAPI hardware-encrypted token storage, auto-Java provisioning, and silent NSIS updates.
PowerShell Quick-Install (Windows 10 / 11)
irm https://raw.githubusercontent.com/untitledinfo/verifed-fireclient/main/scripts/install-windows.ps1 | iex
macOS Universal Desktop Edition (macOS 12 Monterey+)
Supports Apple Silicon (M1 / M2 / M3 / M4 arm64) & Intel Macs (x64) with macOS Keychain token encryption, Adoptium macOS JDK auto-setup, and Metal/LWJGL thread support.
1-Line macOS Terminal Installer (Auto-mounts & clears Gatekeeper quarantine)
curl -fsSL https://raw.githubusercontent.com/untitledinfo/verifed-fireclient/main/scripts/install-macos.sh | bash
Linux Desktop Edition (Ubuntu, Debian, Fedora, Arch, SteamOS)
Native Linux desktop packages (x86_64 & arm64) with Secret Service / libsecret encrypted auth, Adoptium Linux JDK provisioning, and .desktop launcher menu entry.
1-Line Linux Terminal Installer (Auto-detects apt/.deb, Fedora, Arch, or AppImage)
curl -fsSL https://raw.githubusercontent.com/untitledinfo/verifed-fireclient/main/scripts/install-linux.sh | bash

Mojang Minecraft EULA & Server Policy
COMPLIANCE REQUIRED
Required by Mojang Studios for dedicated server hosting
Official Mojang Studios Policy
Every dedicated Minecraft server instance requires explicit agreement to the Minecraft End User License Agreement (EULA) and Commercial Usage Guidelines. FireClient automatically configures eula=true to guarantee clean server startups.
Key Requirements for Hosting a Minecraft Server:
No Pay-to-Win
You may not sell gameplay advantages, overpowered kits, or competitive pay-walls. Only purely cosmetic perks, ranks, or fair server access fees are permitted.
Player Safety
Operators must maintain a welcoming environment free of hate speech, toxic harassment, or unlawful content.
Brand Protection
You may not name or promote your server in any manner that implies it is an official Mojang or Microsoft project.
Network Anti-Abuse
*.fireclient.net subdomains may not be pointed to malicious hosts, DDoS targets, or botnets.
Legal, Privacy & Cloudflare Security

Local-First Privacy & Data Protection

FireClient operates on a strict local-first architecture. We believe players should enjoy Minecraft without surveillance, profiling, or unwanted telemetry.

Zero Telemetry Guarantee: FireClient contains no tracking pixels, no advertising trackers, no user activity beacons, and no telemetry SDKs.

Hardware-Backed Token Encryption (Windows DPAPI): Your Microsoft / Xbox credentials are authenticated via official OAuth 2.0 PKCE. Saved tokens in accounts.json are encrypted on disk using the Windows Data Protection API (CryptProtectData) bound to your Windows user security descriptor and device TPM.

Game Save Isolation: Worlds, resource packs, shaders, and screenshots are stored exclusively on your PC in %APPDATA%\.fireclient and are never uploaded or harvested.

Terms of Service

By using FireClient, you agree to comply with our Terms of Service and applicable third-party provider terms.

Server Hosting: Operating a server using FireClient requires full compliance with the Mojang Minecraft EULA and Commercial Usage Guidelines. Pay-to-win practices and abusive operations are strictly prohibited.

Cloud Domains: Free *.fireclient.net subdomains are provisioned for legitimate multiplayer gaming. Phishing, impersonating servers like Hypixel, malware hosting, or DDoS target redirection will result in immediate subdomain termination.

Cloudflare Enterprise Security Whitepaper

FireClient partners with Cloudflare Edge Network technologies to deliver ultra-fast DNS propagation, DDOS defense, and zero-port tunneling.

Least-Privilege API Token Isolation: FireClient's API token is scoped strictly to Zone:DNS:Edit on the fireclient.net zone. The token has zero access to account settings, user billing, or SSL private keys.

Cloudflare Tunnel (cloudflared): Establishes an outbound-only encrypted QUIC/TLS stream from your PC to Cloudflare's nearest Anycast edge. Your residential IP address remains hidden, and zero incoming router ports are required.

DNS Rebinding Protection: Registrations strictly reject internal loopback IPs (127.0.0.1, 0.0.0.0, localhost) from public A-records, while providing intelligent client loopback routing for the host machine.
